'''Biko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Biko lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he was fourteen, he had became a member of a small gang consisting of himself, [[Naja Delan]], [[Oora Gellandi]] and [[Meera Lisso]]. The gang was present in the [[platform city]] of [[Bayonard]] when they overhead members of a [[Thaereian military]] hit [[Squad/Legends|squad]] discussing their plans to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the diplomat [[Gavid Lermyn]]. Biko and his friends did not realize the significance of the information they had heard, but shortly afterwards assisted the [[Heroes of Cularin]] in thwarting the plot to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Lermyn.<ref name="Padawannabes" />
